pose: A massive, cylindrical steel buoy painted charcoal grey, topped with a prominent glass gantry holding a glowing emerald-green lantern. Several small pterosaurs have nested on top of the lantern structure, looking out across the open sea.

environmental_details.ground: Deep blue-grey ocean water with swells that lift and lower the buoy. White limestone foam breaks gently around its waterlines.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Clear, crisp atmospheric perspective over an infinite horizon, emphasizing the vast scale of the pelagic ocean.
